headline: The emergency credit-bureau transfer is well specified, but the action grader cannot tell whether the agent escalated immediately or verified first, as the task intends.

issues.summary: Doc_012 asks for immediate escalation with no identity verification: emergency tool first, then transfer. ACTION grading ignores order and extra calls, so an agent that verifies or troubleshoots first, or transfers before the emergency call, still passes.
evidence: src/tau2/evaluator/evaluator_action.py _check_actions: each gold action passes if any predicted tool call matches it (order and count ignored)
Action.compare_with_tool_call: compare_args [] -> name match only; call_discoverable_agent_tool golds use compare_args ['agent_tool_name']

doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_012: "Identity verification is NOT required for this incident protocol. IMMEDIATELY use emergency_credit_bureau_incident_transfer_1114() then transfer_to_human_agents."
description.notes: "requires IMMEDIATE transfer without identity verification or troubleshooting"
issues.why_it_matters: The 'immediate, no verification' part of the test is not graded. Correct work still passes.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an ordered check, or a check that log_verification was not called, if immediacy is meant to be tested.

solution_check: The customer reports a sudden credit-score drop from a Rho-Bank delinquency report. Doc_012 is active 11/14/2025 to 11/18/2025, and the clock is 11/14/2025. The prescribed actions are unlock and call emergency_credit_bureau_incident_transfer_1114, then transfer_to_human_agents, which is the gold.
prior_note: The prior review rated this task clean. Under the calibration rule for grader-invisible order, it is Minor. This is the weakest case in the 032-035 group, since the only invisible rules are 'then' and 'no verification'.
notes: ACTION only. The customer has only apply_for_credit_card, so no user-side DB effects are possible.
